walkthroughs.body_html:
Unit 2: Listening, Reading and Use of French — a core area of A-Level French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Unit 2: Listening, Reading and Use of French brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Unit 2: Listening, Reading and Use of French.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: When does the past participle agree with avoir verbs?
options: When the direct object comes BEFORE the verb (la pomme que j'ai mangée).
Never - avoir never causes agreement.
Always.
Sensible to touch.
Sensible to touch.
Sensible (showing good judgment).
Always.
Sensitive (emotionally).
